title: Incident #4536 — Missing User Orders in Analytics
scenario: The data team received reports that the user orders analytics dashboard is showing fewer orders than expected. Find the bug.
code:
SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY u.user_id;

options.text: The date filter should include orders from last year.
The join type should be a LEFT JOIN instead of INNER JOIN.
The COUNT function should use DISTINCT order_id.
The user_id should be filtered to exclude inactive users.

explanation: The code uses an INNER JOIN, which excludes users without any orders, leading to missing data in the report. Switching to a LEFT JOIN ensures all users are included, regardless of whether they have placed orders.
